about: Gathers what a person moves around an application by: a fixed head, blocks of destinations that scroll, and a fixed foot.

iconic.about: The column as it is, and collapsed to a rail of marks. The headings and the search leave the rail, and the destinations keep their words out of sight for a screen reader.
iconic.title: Iconic

size.about: Every size. The size moves the insets, the gaps and the words of every band together.
size.title: Sizes

title: Sidebar

variant.about: Every look. Each column is drawn in a room the width of a sidebar, because a sidebar states nothing about how wide it is and the shell around it decides that.
variant.title: Looks
